title: Back on track
tagline: Bills and debts in one calm overview, free help when you want it, and no new credit pushed at you.
trigger: Buy-now-pay-later payments that keep piling up, direct debits that bounce, or a bailiff payment.

steps.title: One honest overview
steps.description: Everything that is due, and when, from your own payments: rent, bills, instalments and what bounced.
steps.why: Based on your own account. Nothing is shared, and no one at KBC judges it.
steps.result: Overview ready: what is due in the next 60 days, ordered by date.

steps.title: Bills after pay day
steps.description: Move direct debits to just after your income arrives, so they stop bouncing and costing fees.
steps.why: We show which ones you can move; you confirm each one.
steps.result: Pay-day plan ready: the direct debits you chose now run after your income arrives.

steps.title: Stop the pay-later stack
steps.description: See every buy-now-pay-later plan in one place, and block new ones on your card if you want.
steps.why: Small instalments add up quietly. You decide; you can lift the block any time.
steps.result: Pay-later overview ready; new pay-later payments on your card are blocked until you lift it.

steps.title: Pay less for your bank
steps.description: If your account package costs more than you use, switch to the basic banking service.
steps.why: KBC earns less on this, and that is the point.
steps.result: Your account package was checked; a cheaper option is ready if you want it.

steps.title: Free help from a debt counsellor
steps.description: A recognised, non-profit debt counselling service that can talk to creditors and a bailiff for you.
steps.why: Free and confidential. The counsellor only receives what you choose to list, and KBC earns nothing from it.

win.partner: An early intake, before debts grow

steps.result: Intake requested with a debt counsellor; they will contact you within two working days.

steps.title: A small buffer, once the arrears are cleared
steps.description: An automatic €10 a week into a free savings account, so one unexpected bill doesn't start it all again.
steps.why: Starts only when you say so, and pauses by itself if your balance runs low.
steps.result: Weekly buffer set, paused automatically when your balance is low.
